ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is amended by changing all of the C1-1,
Neighborhood Commercial District and C2-5, Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 6-F in the area bound by:

South Archer Avenue; South Canal Street; and West 23" Place,
to those of a B2-5, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

T. Lee
Alderman, 11° Ward

Common Addresses:
2323-2325 S. Archer Avenue
2310-2326 S. Canal Street
